title: Native boot rejects an otherwise permitted job override only after provisioning
body: check-native-boot.sh accepted UNDERSET_BOOT_JOBS=4 until native_boot_jobs.py rejected it after provisioning with the live safe limit of 3; rerunning with UNDERSET_BOOT_JOBS=3 worked around the failure. Suggested consolidation: expose the queue-admitted native job cap before provisioning or clamp/report the usable value in one documented preflight.

title: VIXEN auto-derive misses assigned Undertow worktree layout
body: VIXEN configure logged the unassigned /home/liory/projects/undertow sibling even though this lane's assigned provider was /home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude/worktrees/vixin03; the paired-lane derivation should recognize both .claude/worktrees and .claude-worktrees (or consume explicit lane pairing) so validation cannot silently use the wrong provider checkout.
